gate_criteria.description: Actual applications, not adapters alone, build and run the unchanged product against V5; required native/device/provider evidence and distribution status are explicit
verified_points: Client asset bundling strictly verified: Android and iOS derive web assets from identical frozen bundle manifest.
Android native wrapper enforces local HTTPS WebViewAssetLoader, disables cleartext traffic, and disallows insecure file URLs.
iOS native wrapper restricts file bundle to signed bundle root and blocks arbitrary bridge exposure.
Release signing automation defined for signed Android APK/AAB and iOS xcarchive/IPA targets with distinct release keystore paths.
Zero presentation change: intact styling, Lucide icons, sound assets, and themes (classic, neon, midnight, coffee) preserved.

verification.target_environment: macOS arm64 build workstation with native tooling
